name: Advanced AI Lab
headline: Explore, Train and Fine-Tune Large Language Models
intro: The AI Lab is a working environment for engineers and researchers who want to understand how modern language models are built, adapted and evaluated. You will move from model internals to production-style systems, and you will measure every change you make.

pillars.title: Model Foundations
pillars.text: Understand attention, tokenization and embeddings well enough to debug a model rather than guess at it.

pillars.title: Fine-Tuning
pillars.text: Adapt open-weight models with LoRA and QLoRA on curated datasets, and track each run so results can be reproduced.

pillars.title: Retrieval and Grounding
pillars.text: Connect models to documents through retrieval pipelines so that answers can be traced to their sources.

pillars.title: Evaluation and Safety
pillars.text: Judge models with held-out tests, human review and red-team exercises before anything reaches users.

capabilities: Preference alignment concepts, including DPO and RLHF
Prompt injection testing for LLM applications

name: Cyber Security Lab
headline: Learn to Attack, Defend and Investigate, Safely
intro: The Cyber Security Lab teaches the skills that organizations rely on: finding weaknesses before attackers do, watching for intrusions, and reconstructing incidents afterwards. Offensive techniques are practiced only in isolated lab networks, under written rules of engagement.

pillars.title: Penetration Testing
pillars.text: Follow a full methodology from reconnaissance to reporting, against systems built for training.

pillars.title: Security Operations
pillars.text: Monitor, triage and hunt threats using SIEM platforms, detection rules and MITRE ATT&CK.

pillars.title: Digital Forensics
pillars.text: Preserve evidence correctly, analyze disk and memory images, and build a verified timeline of an intrusion.

pillars.title: Application and Cloud Security
pillars.text: Find and fix authorization, injection and configuration flaws in web applications, APIs and cloud environments.

capabilities: Web application testing with Burp Suite and OWASP ZAP
Active Directory attack paths and defensive hardening
Log analysis and detection engineering with Sigma rules
Disk and memory forensics with Autopsy and Volatility
Professional reporting with risk ratings and remediation
